sources.entry: Switzy - Open-source tool for switching Git identities and managing SSH keys. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/yefga/Switzy) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: Switzy is a Git identity manager for macOS (with Linux and Windows placeholders) that works on a shared Git/SSH core, with a SwiftUI/AppKit menu bar app as the only supported application.
summary.what_it_does: Switzy is described as a Git identity manager built on a shared Foundation-only core for Git profiles, Git config, shell commands, and SSH key handling. The current supported application is a macOS menu bar app written in SwiftUI/AppKit and managed with a Tuist project. The repository includes Sparkle update metadata (appcast.xml), a Homebrew cask copy, and release tooling. The Linux/ and Windows/ directories are placeholders only, with no builds supported yet. The README does not list the specific switching or SSH key features beyond these descriptions.
use_cases: manage SSH keys for different Git accounts
menu bar Git profile switcher on macOS
install a Git identity tool via Homebrew
notable: Shared Foundation-only Git/SSH core intended to be reused across platforms
Native SwiftUI/AppKit menu bar app for macOS
Sparkle appcast kept at repo root for existing macOS clients
caveats: Only the macOS app is supported; Linux and Windows directories are placeholders with no builds yet
Installation and development details are in a separate macOS/README.md, not covered here
keywords: switch git user name and email
